asset: Oculus Touch v3 / Quest 2 controller models
commit_description: Adding profile and assets for oculus-touch-v3 (Quest 2) controllers
license_notice: Copyright (c) 2019 Amazon. Full notice retained in LICENSE.txt and LICENSE.md.
license_evidence: Upstream packages/assets/README.md explicitly licenses its glTF/glb assets under MIT.
trademark_notice: Device trademarks depict the corresponding physical device. No manufacturer endorsement or rights to alternate trademark-bearing controller skins are implied. See upstream packages/assets/README.md#trademarks.
modifications: None to GLB files. Godot imports them and the application interpolates their authored control-node ranges at runtime.
derived_files: The left_/right_ color PNG and ambient-occlusion/metallic/roughness JPEG files in this folder are Godot's unedited extractions of the two embedded images from each source GLB. They retain the same MIT license. Import sidecars preserve the texture/resource dependencies for a fresh checkout; .godot runtime/import caches are excluded from source control.
runtime_preference: OpenXRFbRenderModel loads the device's own model when available. Runtime model data is not stored in this repository or exported as an asset. Unknown runtime node layouts remain static; automatic animation is not assumed.
